reviewer_blinding: The author is not blinded to its own prompt. The following first visual description omits source keywords and intensity labels; it is not an independent blinded experiment.
first_visual_description: A short-haired woman leans toward a hospital records window holding an empty clear sleeve. A file bearing a similar portrait stands beyond glass, while a visibly barred EXIT is immediately behind her. Empty chairs and numbered doors recede through a clean bright corridor. Her paused hands and open mouth hold the foreground; the warm records office and cold corridor separate the two sides.
scene_legibility: The empty sleeve, inaccessible file and barred exit connect into a readable administrative obstruction. The exact previous exchange, whose file it is and why the hospital is unresponsive are not independently proven by the still image.
genre_observation: Clear clinical institutional suspense; medical-horror atmosphere is partial rather than overwhelming. The bolt is the strongest ominous relation.
aesthetic_observation: The diagonal counter, foreground face and folder create a coherent visual triangle, with restrained cool/warm contrast and realistic worn metal. The portrait is compelling, but its prominence and bright cleanliness soften the intended dread.

control_calibration.technical_binding: Frozen controls preserved through audited runtime.
control_calibration.perceived_expression: A subtle attractive human portrayal remains a supporting quality; no added fetish focus or physically impossible event dominates. These are qualitative observations, not a measurement of ordinal control values.

limits: No actual diagnosis, biography, consent or mental state of the reference person is inferred.
The chart portrait supports fictional association but does not establish real-world identity.
Prompt/runtime audit success is not pixel success.
No newly integrated source was adopted; this image cannot prove a causal improvement from that data.
